caption:
Welcome to ByteBaithak.

A baithak is where people sit together and learn. This account is that baithak for tech.

It is run by a senior network engineer and Cisco Networking Academy instructor from Pakistan.

Here you will learn:
- AI and Machine Learning
- DevOps and Cloud Computing
- Coding and Linux
- AI news, explained simply

We are starting with a complete DevOps course, step by step. Complete courses on AI, Machine Learning, coding and cloud computing come next.

Whether you are a student, a junior developer or a network engineer moving to cloud, you are in the right place.

What do you want to learn first?
